entities.name: Ethyl ester hydrolysis
observations: The encoded reaction converts an aryl ethyl ester, Ar-C(=O)OCH2CH3, to the corresponding carboxylic acid, Ar-C(=O)OH.
The scaffold's amide and heterocyclic framework is retained; no oxidation, cyclization, or skeletal rearrangement is indicated.

entities.name: LiOH hydrolysis conditions
observations: An exact or near-exact precedent uses LiOH in water, methanol, and a cyclic ether solvent represented as THF/1,4-dioxane-like in the source record, followed by acidic workup to furnish the carboxylic acid.

observations: High-confidence reagent for base-promoted hydrolysis of the encoded ethyl ester.
